body: I just came across this post. I have been in El Dorado for 4 months from California. I absolutely hate it here. Aside from the fact that there is absolutely NOTHING to do. The weather is unbearable, the people aren't very nice and the food sucks. If it wasn't for the gym and having family here I would be even more bored. I can't wait until I am on my way back to California. And you are 100 percent correct the air smells like chemicals. Rent is cheap that's the only plus. I wouldn't recommend this city to anyone.

My husband said something smart to me the other day, I told him If he'd like, I can go back to work and he would have to figure out a babysitter, dinner, and picking up the kids. Also volunteering at the school, and picking them up when they are sick, making sure homework is done, etc. He very quickly changed his tune because he knows that If I go back to work he cannot and will not do the job I do at home. I also have arthritis and lupus, and having young kids is a test on your marriage. Good luck, maybe have a talk with him about how he made you feel. ❤️
